description.value: A small provincial campground tucked into a canyon along Highway 20, where the glacier-blue Chilcotin River runs past the sites and a short riverside interpretive trail provides an easy evening stretch. The only provincial park on the long Hwy 20 corridor between Williams Lake and Tweedsmuir, making it a natural anchor — though the river is too cold and fast for swimming.

address.value: 6 km west of Alexis Creek, Highway 20, BC
